product_overview: StockFlow AI is an Adobe Stock portfolio management dashboard for organizing, reviewing, and preparing AI-generated stock assets for submission. It helps users manage uploads, quality control, metadata, seasonal planning, prompt templates, exports, and rejection feedback in one workflow.
core_goals: Securely access the portfolio dashboard with a master password
Review portfolio performance and production progress at a glance
Upload assets, detect duplicates, and run quality control
Generate and edit compliant SEO metadata for stock submissions
Plan production around seasonal windows and category quotas
Manage versioned prompt templates and series quotas
Export submission-ready CSV batches for Adobe Stock
Analyze rejection patterns and import earnings to improve future output

features.name: Master Password Authentication
features.description: Provides password-gated access to the dashboard using a local master password flow.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter the master password -> Submit the login form -> See access granted and enter the dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Enter an incorrect password -> Submit the login form -> See an error message and remain on the login screen

features.name: Executive KPI Dashboard & Analytics
features.description: Shows high-level production metrics, seasonal alerts, health scoring, and visual pipeline analytics.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View weekly production target, seasonal alerts, and portfolio health score cards -> Review the production pipeline chart and category balance chart -> Open recent asset links from the dashboard

features.name: Assets Ingestion, Deduplication & Quality Control
features.description: Lets users upload image assets, detect duplicates, run QC, inspect analysis results, and apply moderation decisions and metadata updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /assets -> Drag and drop PNG or JPG files into the upload area -> View uploaded assets appear in the list -> Select one or more assets for review -> Run quality control on the selected assets -> Review sharpness, artifact, IP risk, and copy-space findings in the inspection panel

Navigate to /assets -> Upload files through the file browser -> Review duplicate detection results -> Choose an asset to inspect -> Open the contextual details drawer -> Apply a manual status override with a reason note
Navigate to /assets -> Select an asset -> Generate compliant SEO metadata -> Review the generated title and keyword set -> Edit the title and keywords -> Save the updated metadata
Navigate to /assets -> Select multiple assets -> Choose a moderation action -> Approve or reject the batch -> Add reviewer notes for rejected items
Navigate to /assets -> Start the QC queue -> Pause the automated review process -> Resume the automated review process

features.name: Seasonal Production Calendar & Quota Balance
features.description: Helps users plan themed production around holiday windows and maintain balanced category quotas.
user_flows: Navigate to /calendar -> View active seasonal windows and quota meters -> Filter themes by window status -> Review which themes are produce-now, upcoming, or late
Navigate to /calendar -> Open the new theme modal -> Enter the theme name, category, target event date, and quarter -> Save the theme -> See the theme added to the production calendar
Navigate to /calendar -> Select an existing theme -> Edit the theme details -> Save the changes -> See the updated calendar entry
Navigate to /calendar -> Select an existing theme -> Delete the theme -> Confirm removal -> See the theme disappear from the calendar

features.name: Versioned Prompt Templates & Series Quota
features.description: Supports managing reusable prompt templates, branching versions, and monitoring series production limits.
user_flows: Navigate to /prompts -> Search for templates by keyword or commercial intent -> Open a prompt template -> Review its current version and details
Navigate to /prompts -> Create a new prompt template -> Enter prompt content -> Save the template -> See it listed in the template library
Navigate to /prompts -> Open an existing template -> Branch the version -> Save the new version -> See the new version without overwriting the original
Navigate to /prompts -> Copy positive or negative prompt text -> Paste it into another workflow -> Reuse the prompt content elsewhere
Navigate to /prompts -> Switch to the series view -> Review usage meters against max quota -> Create or edit a series linked to parent themes -> Save the quota settings

features.name: Adobe Stock Pre-Flight Checklist & Batch CSV Export
features.description: Validates export readiness and generates Adobe-compatible UTF-8 CSV batches for submission.
user_flows: Navigate to /export -> Review the pre-flight checklist statuses -> Confirm assets are export ready -> Select all export-ready assets -> Generate the CSV batch -> Download the exported file
Navigate to /export -> Review the pre-flight checklist statuses -> Select specific assets only -> Generate the CSV batch -> Download the resulting CSV file
Navigate to /export -> Generate a CSV batch -> Confirm submission -> Mark the selected assets as submitted -> See the pipeline status advance

features.name: Feedback Loop, Prompt Advisor & Calibration Matrix
features.description: Surfaces rejection patterns, recommends prompt improvements, tracks moderator alignment, and imports earnings data.
user_flows: Navigate to /rejections -> Review rejection taxonomy breakdown cards -> Adjust the acceptance threshold slider -> Observe how the warning threshold changes

Navigate to /rejections -> Open the AI Prompt Advisor for a struggling template -> Review the rationale, upgraded positive prompt, and targeted negative prompt -> Apply the recommendation as a new template version
Navigate to /rejections -> Review the confusion matrix -> Compare Gemini QC outcomes with moderator decisions -> Use the calibration view to assess model alignment
Navigate to /rejections -> Import an Adobe Sales CSV file -> Preview the earnings data -> Complete the import into the earnings view

features.name: System Settings & Compliance Policy
features.description: Allows users to maintain a brand blacklist and review portfolio health formula definitions.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Add brand or trademark names to the blacklist -> Save the blacklist -> See the new restricted terms in the list
Navigate to /settings -> Remove a brand tag from the blacklist -> Save the changes -> See the blacklist updated
Navigate to /settings -> Read the health score documentation -> Review the definitions for approval rate, diversity, similarity, and freshness

routes.description: Main Creator Dashboard with KPI cards, production pipeline charts, and recent activity
Assets management with multi-file drag-drop upload, pHash deduplication, Gemini Vision QC, and SEO metadata drawer
Seasonal production calendar tracking H-90 to H-30 holiday windows and quota balancing
Versioned prompt templates engine and series max quota tracking
Pre-flight checklist and Adobe Stock UTF-8 batch CSV export generator
Rejection taxonomy root cause patterns, Gemini AI Prompt Advisor, earnings CSV import, and QC calibration
Brand blacklist management, Adobe business limits, and Health Score formula documentation
